method: Named source bone surface registration plus smooth displacement; attachment patches are preserved source muscle vertices nearest the documented bone. Distances use closest points on 32 nearby target triangles and conservatively bound true surface distance. This is a geometric teaching-model check, not validated tendon-footprint or specimen anatomy.
